description: 生产交付 live evidence bundle 装配契约。该装配器消费 closure work queue、proof-ref gate、category runbooks，以及操作员提供的脱敏 live summary JSON，把 production API、HF Space、Telegram Bot、公网 webhook 和多端 live parity 的通过证据转换为 external-validation-live-proof-gate 可校验的 live evidence bundle。

acceptedEvidenceInputs.additionalRequirement: production API、HF Space 和 Telegram Bot checks must all be pass in live-release-gate.json.

assemblyPolicy.pendingMode: No evidence or incomplete evidence produces status=external_connectivity_pending and liveProofs=[] or partial liveProofs.
assemblyPolicy.proofRefDependency: A live proof can only be emitted for work items whose proofRef was already schema-accepted by external-validation-proof-ref-gate.
assemblyPolicy.runbookDependency: Each live proof must bind to the category runbook id for the same category.
assemblyPolicy.artifactPolicy: The emitted artifactHash is the sha256 digest of the operator-provided summary JSON; raw summary body is not copied.
assemblyPolicy.shipGate: This assembler never changes ship/certification status by itself; external-validation-live-proof-gate and measurement-infrastructure-certification remain authoritative.

privacyBoundary: Assembler output may contain proof id、proofRefId、workItemId、owner、category、runbookId、liveGateKind、artifactHash、sourceBinding、operatorAttestation 和脱敏命令；不得复制真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not execute production API/HF/Bot/Postgres/webhook checks.
Does not verify hidden external artifacts without operator and audit review.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
